verdicts.why: Electrical cable scrap is the same kind of recycled aluminium cable described in the advert.
The model states an 84.7L engine, contradicting the advertised and photographed 4.7L engine.
The model identifies the same Elepaq gasoline generator, with a more specific model designation.
A car alternator is the same item as the alternator advertised for the Mercedes engine.
Self-help and leadership books are consistent with the advertised motivational books.
The model names a 200L tank, while the advert and photos show a 1,000-liter IBC tank.
The model identifies law books, matching the advertised collection of law textbooks.
A car headlight is the same item as the advertised car headlamp.
The model gives model TC110-18, while the photos identify the Jincheng JC110-19 motorcycle.
The model names an engine mount, but the photos show a gearbox or transmission mount.
The model identifies the same M-Audio MIDI keyboards shown in the photos.
IBC drums are another name for the plastic IBC tote tank shown in the photos.
A manual transmission is a gearbox and is consistent with the photos, which allow either manual or automatic.
The model names an industrial generator, while the photos show a generator alternator.
The model names a sewer truck, but the photos show a mixed scrap-metal lot including a scrap sewage truck.
